description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Don Roshan Manoj Priyantha Jayasingha of Mathugama Pradeshiya Sabha and Mr. Nimal Thommadura of Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha as Chairman
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in the office of Chairman for local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including declarations of elected officials to fill positions that became vacant due to resignation and death. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the electoral process for local authorities.
